evals.prompt: /add-tracker plan only, don't build anything yet: I want a tracker for my houseplants — name, room, when I last watered each one and how often it needs water, so I can see which are thirsty. Just for me, no sharing.
evals.expected_output: A spec plus exact Workflow args choosing SwiftData (ParcelTracker reference), a plant model with raw-string enums/inline defaults, a unique accent and SF Symbol, a 'due for water' home detail, and no workflow launched.
assertions: Chooses SwiftData (not Core Data) because no sharing was requested
Adds the models to the module's models array and AppSchema.models
Watering-due logic takes asOf now: Date = .now
Gives concrete Workflow args JSON with storage swiftdata
Did not modify the repo or launch a workflow (plan only)
Root view plan follows Module chrome: sections declared on the module enum and the root view built with ModuleTabView
Enum-like status/cycle fields are stored as raw strings with a computed accessor
Lists every app-shell wiring point: project.yml packages + appDependencies, HomeView SelectedModule + moduleContent, AppSettingsView row, AllPackageTests scheme test target
Names the CloudKit schema ritual (-InitializeCloudKitSchema, deploy to Production) as a manual follow-up
Picks an accent colour and SF Symbol and checks they don't collide with existing modules
